thread:
alyssa: Quick heads-up — we need to hand off ownership of the runtime param 'prefix_cache_size' from infra to platform. It's affecting canary batching and we should coordinate safe rollout.
samir: Who's currently owning it? I thought infra set defaults, but platform has the canary logic. :thinking_face:
marta: infra set the initial defaults when we added KV prefix caching, but platform owns rollout policies. We ended up with mixed responsibilities.
alyssa: Right. Proposal: platform owns policy & rollout (percent, cohorts), infra maintains implementation and exposes API. Hand-off doc + runbook needed.
jordan: +1. Also need a deterministic canary cohort selection to avoid biased routes. Current cohort hashing is user_id % 100 which skews for internal traffic.
taylor: Can we use request_id hashing or a composite route hash? internal traffic tends to have small user_id values.
samir: Suggestion: extend the config API with a 'cohort_selector' enum. Values: 'user_hash', 'request_hash', 'tenant_hash'. Default stays user_hash.
marta: That requires a small runtime change. We should be careful about migration — old configs without cohort_selector should behave the same.
alyssa: For rollout safety, add these checks in console: 1) preview impact estimation, 2) telemetry gating with min sample size, 3) automatic rollback threshold.
jordan: Agreed. What metrics do we gate on? latency_p50, error_rate, and model_throughput? We also need quota burn rate.
taylor: telemetry suggestion: compute delta over baseline per-cohort for latency_p50 and qps. If latency_p50 increases > 10% for 3 consecutive minutes -> fail.
samir: Ops: can deploy-bot annotate deploys so that config rollouts tie to deploy ids. deploy-bot: can we attach last_deploy_id automatically?
deploy-bot: Yes, we can add deploy tag in config events. Need PR to infra/eventing.
marta: Ops-side: add a dry-run mode where prefix_cache_size is applied locally in request path but doesn't affect kv eviction. That lets us measure hit rate changes.
alyssa: Add UI affordances: toggle Dry-run, Preview sample size, select Cohort selector, set Rollout schedule (linear over X minutes), set Rollback thresholds.
jordan: UX note: show a small simulated traffic preview chart for selected cohort. If cohort_selector=request_hash we should warn about non-determinism for retries.
taylor: For ownership doc: sections: Responsibilities, API surface, Console UI fields, Telemetry signals, Runbook steps, Communication (who to ping). I'll draft.
alyssa: Great. One more: rate-limited quick overrides for emergencies. Overrides should be auditable and TTLed.
marta: We'll add an 'override' field with {owner, reason, ttl, audit_link} in the config event model.
samir: Edge-case: rolling back a config that changed schema (e.g., removed field) — need schema versioning for configs.
alyssa: Let's land these as RFC + follow up PRs: 1) RFC for ownership & schema (marta), 2) Console UX mock & telemetry gating (taylor + jordan), 3) Runtime change for cohort_selector & dry-run (samir), 4) deploy-bot tagging (ops-bot).
ops-bot: Acknowledged. I can coordinate on deploy tagging slot. Will also add a kanban card.
alyssa: Timeline? Would like RFCs this week and a lightweight prototype next sprint.
jordan: I'll mock charts by EOD for the preview.
taylor: Will draft the console wireframes tomorrow.
marta: I'll start the runtime branch and add a feature flag to gate cohort_selector.
samir: Ping me when branches are linked. I'll help on telemetry hooks.
alyssa: Thanks all :thumbsup: Let's use #eng-platform for progress updates and tag this thread when PRs are ready.
